name: Navkar Bhav (@navkarbhav)
format: One Jain story (Tirthankaras, saints, kings, Jain festivals and practices) with one clear lesson, 40-75 s; every story names its source (Agam / Kalpasutra / Adipurana / Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra)

voice.style: a calm, gentle Hindi storyteller with deep respect, soft and warm like an elder telling a story after evening prayers, clear pronunciation of Prakrit and Sanskrit names, a quiet emotional pause at the turning point; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences

visuals.look: serene painterly Indian style, soft saffron, gold and white marble light, calm and peaceful, ornate Jain temple details, gentle glow, uncluttered
visuals.cast: the story's people in ancient Indian attire, calm faces; Tirthankaras only as serene meditating temple idols (seated padmasana or standing kayotsarga, eyes half closed, with their emblem) or as symbols (lotus, light, footprints, the siddhashila crescent), never as action characters; Jain monks and nuns in plain white robes with a broom (rajoharan); never Hindu gods, never weapons in a Tirthankara's hands

painting.use: the main story: the people, the place, the moment itself (default, most scenes)
painting.pic: serene painterly Indian style, soft saffron, gold and white marble light, calm and peaceful, ornate Jain temple details, gentle glow, uncluttered

manuscript.use: a scene from scripture, a past life, a Tirthankara's life event, the cosmos (lokakash), the meaning of the story
manuscript.pic: Jain Kalpasutra manuscript painting: flat vermilion red ground, gold leaf and ultramarine blue, fine black outlines, stylised figures in profile, ornamental border motifs, palm-leaf and paper texture, one single scene

rules: respectful, no mockery, no sect bashing: when Shwetambar and Digambar versions differ, say so
sourced stories only (Agam, Kalpasutra, Adipurana, Trishashti-shalaka-purusha-charitra, Uttaradhyayana); name the source
never mix Hindu gods or Hindu iconography into Jain stories
no miracles claimed as history, no medical or astrological claims

theme.end_line: Jai Jinendra. Kal ek nayi katha
